藏品名称_EN: Red-painted round box with nine dragons
描述_EN: A reddish-red round box with nine dragons，the Ming dynasty (1368-1402)，your (honorific)8.2centimetre，calibre19.8centimetre。collection of old treasures from the Qing dynasty。　　wooden box with wooden tires，orbicular，flat roof，straight wall，flat bottomed，lit. lying down on one's feet。Carved with red lacquer pattern on yellow lacquer。The cover is decorated with a cloudy dragon pattern，Longfa forward stroke，close one's mouth，physically capable，black lacquer on both eyes。Wall decorated with cloud pattern。Black lacquer on the inside and outside of the box，poem written in gold and decorated with the emperor's handwriting：“The Yongle Creation of Cinnabar Lacquer，Wenson should have seen it.。formerly worked from orchards，similar to Kendang。ochre coloring，fig. extremely fine grain (of writing)。Kowloon Geographic Information System，Weng Yi, Feng Ben Shou, president of the Republic of China (1993-1994)。Qianlong Wuxu Imperial Inscription。”furthermore“Yin and Yang”、“sound of drums”two-sided seal。Engraved on the left side of the outer foot in gilt regular script“大the Ming dynasty (1368-1402)年制”vertical stroke with six characters (in Chinese characters)。　　This box has a heavy body，red lacquer，Pure paint color，Fine lacquer，Mellow carving，skillful handling of the knife，Ground smooth，graphic pattern compact，The dragons are carved in a majestic and powerful manner，All aspects reflect the characteristics of Xuande lacquerware。
描述_ZN: A red-brushed floral marigold holder, Ming Yongle, 10 cm high, 12 cm in diameter, 21 cm in dish diameter, 11.4 cm in foot diameter. Old Qing Palace collection.　　The rest is composed of a rounded calabash, a sunflower-petal-shaped dish, and a flared footrim, inherited from the Song dynasty with slight variations in proportion. The body is carved in red lacquer pattern on a yellow lacquer plain ground. Calendula, plate, and foot are ring carved with six flowers between the top and bottom, including peony, chrysanthemum, pomegranate, gardenia, and tea flower. Bracket to the foot is hollow, painted ochre lacquer, the right side of the foot needle scratch "Da Ming Yongle year system" line script.　　The holder can be divided into three parts from top to bottom, and the arrangement of the floral motifs on each of the four decorative surfaces is different.
